title: Create a domain mapper
description: Creates a Mapper<From, To> class that translates between representations at an architectural boundary.

name.description: Mapper name in PascalCase, for example TripDtoToTrip.
name.x-prompt: What is the mapper name? (e.g. TripDtoToTrip)

directory.description: Directory where the mapper file will be created, for example libs/domains/orders/infrastructure/src/lib/mappers.
